question: Can CRA charge interest if I pay less than my required income tax instalment?
generated_answer:
CRA can charge interest if you pay less than your required income tax instalment. The interest rate is set quarterly and is compounded daily. The interest is calculated on the amount of the instalment that was not paid on time.

For example, if you were required to pay $1,000 in instalments for the 2021 tax year and you only paid $500, you would be charged interest on the $500 that was not paid on time.

The interest rate for the first quarter of 2022 is 1%. If you were charged interest for the 2021 tax year, the interest would be calculated as follows:

Interest = (Unpaid instalment amount) x (Interest rate) x (Number of days late)

In this example, the interest would be:

Interest = $500 x 1% x 90 days (assuming the instalment was due on March 15, 2021, and you paid on June 15, 2021)

Interest = $500 x 0.01 x 90 = $45

So, you would be charged $45 in interest for paying less than your required income tax instalment.

It's worth noting that if you pay less than your required instalment, you may also be charged a penalty. The penalty is usually 5% of the amount that was not paid on time, plus 1% for each month that the instalment is late, up to a maximum of 12 months. In this example, the penalty would be 5% of $500, which is $25, plus 1% for each of the 3 months that the instalment was late, which is an additional $15. So, the total penalty would be $40.

To avoid interest and penalties, it's a good idea to make sure you're paying your required income tax instalments on time. You can use the CRA's online calculator to determine your required instalment amount, and you can also set up automatic payments through your bank or through the CRA's online payment system.

If you're having trouble paying your instalments, you may want to consider speaking with a tax professional or contacting the CRA to discuss your options. They may be able to offer you a payment plan or other assistance to help you get back on track.
